license_required.quote: A person may not act as an emergency medical services provider unless the person is licensed under this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Program is established within the Oregon Health Authority for the purpose of administering a comprehensive statewide emergency medical services system

name.quote: A person desiring to be licensed as an emergency medical services provider shall submit an application for licensure to the Oregon Health Authority.

type.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Program is established within the Oregon Health Authority

age_minimum.quote: Is 16 years of age or older if the applicant is applying for a license at the emergency medical responder level.

degree_required.value: successful completion of an authority-approved training course
degree_required.quote: The applicant has successfully completed a training course approved by the authority.

exams.name: Emergency medical services provider written examination
exams.quote: An applicant shall submit a nonrefundable examination fee for the following purposes: (a) Emergency medical services provider written examination;

exams.name: Emergency medical services provider practical examination
exams.quote: (b) Emergency medical services provider practical examination;

exams.name: National examination
exams.notes: Authority may utilize a national examination agency or other examination service
exams.quote: (c) A fee deemed necessary by the Oregon Health Authority to cover the fee charged by the national examination agency or other examination service utilized by the authority for the purpose of examining candidates for an emergency medical services provider license.

interval_years.quote: Each license issued under this section, unless sooner suspended or revoked, expires and is renewable after a period of two years.

required.quote: A person licensed under this section shall submit, at the time of application for renewal of the license to the authority, evidence of the applicant's satisfactory completion of an authority approved program of continuing education and other requirements prescribed by rule by the authority.

available.quote: The authority may issue an emergency medical services provider license by indorsement without proof of completion of an approved training course to an emergency medical services provider who is licensed to practice emergency care in another state of the United States or a foreign country if, in the opinion of the authority, the applicant meets the requirements for licensure in this state

requirements.value: License by endorsement available to out-of-state EMS providers; authority may substitute experience and national registry certification for education requirements.
requirements.quote: The Oregon Health Authority shall adopt rules to allow an applicant for licensure by indorsement as an emergency medical services provider to substitute experience and certification by a national registry of emergency medical services providers for education requirements imposed by the authority.

exists.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board is established within the Oregon Health Authority.

name.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board is established within the Oregon Health Authority.

authority.value: The board provides advice and recommendations to the Emergency Medical Services Program on evidence-based practices, workforce needs, licensure and discipline rules, and regional planning; also recommends rules for adoption by the Oregon Health Authority.
authority.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board shall provide advice and recommendations to the Emergency Medical Services Program

national_certification.value: National Registry of Emergency Medical Services Providers
national_certification.quote: The Oregon Health Authority shall adopt rules to allow an applicant for licensure by indorsement as an emergency medical services provider to substitute experience and certification by a national registry of emergency medical services providers for education requirements imposed by the authority.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not act as an emergency medical services provider unless the person is licensed under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: When exemption is granted under this section, any person who attends an individual who is ill or injured or who has a disability in an ambulance may not purport to be an emergency medical services provider.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not act as an emergency medical services provider unless the person is licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to have successfully completed an authority-approved course
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A failure to have completed successfully an authority approved course.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to meet or continue to meet the physical and mental qualifications required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to meet or continue to meet the physical and mental qualifications required under ORS 682.208.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud or deception in receiving a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of fraud or deception in receiving a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing skills beyond the established scope of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing skills beyond the scope of practice established by the Oregon Medical Board under ORS 682.245.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Rendering emergency or nonemergency care under an assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Rendering emergency or nonemergency care under an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of another emergency medical services provider
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The impersonation of another emergency medical services provider.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the chapter
Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use of intoxicants or drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use of intoxicants or drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presence of a mental disorder that demonstrably affects performance, as certified by two psychiatrists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The presence of a mental disorder that demonstrably affects an emergency medical services provider's performance, as certified by two psychiatrists retained by the authority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any criminal offense that reasonably raises questions about the ability to perform EMS duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to ORS 670.280, conviction of any criminal offense that reasonably raises questions about the ability of the emergency medical services provider to perform the duties of an emergency medical services provider in accordance with the standards established by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of an EMS provider license issued by another state for a reason that would permit Oregon to suspend or revoke the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of an emergency medical services provider license issued by another state: (A) For a reason that would permit the authority to suspend or revoke a license issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in rendering emergency medical assistance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence or repeated negligence in rendering emergency medical assistance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Rendering emergency or nonemergency care without being licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Rendering emergency or nonemergency care without being licensed, except as provided in ORS 30.800.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Rendering care as an EMS provider without written authorization and standing orders from an approved supervising physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Rendering emergency or nonemergency care as an emergency medical services provider without written authorization and standing orders from a supervising physician who has been approved by the Oregon Medical Board in accordance with ORS 682.245.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing an invitation for an interview with the authority as specified
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing an invitation for an interview with the authority as specified in this section.

bonding_required.quote: A bond conditioned for the paying in behalf of the principal, the limits of financial responsibility mentioned in subsection (1) of this section;

insurance_required.quote: the owner of an ambulance or ambulance service, other than a governmental unit, shall file and maintain with the Oregon Health Authority proof of ability to respond in damages for liability

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A license for an ambulance service or the operation of ambulance vehicles shall be obtained from the Oregon Health Authority.

definition_quote.value: Emergency medical services provider means a person who has received formal training in prehospital and emergency care, and is licensed to attend any person who is ill or injured or who has a disability.
definition_quote.quote: "Emergency medical services provider" means a person who has received formal training in prehospital and emergency care, and is licensed to attend any person who is ill or injured or who has a disability.

value: observation, care and counsel of persons who are ill or injured or who have disabilities
administration of care or medications prescribed by a licensed physician or naturopathic physician
prehospital emergency care based on approved curriculum
nonemergency care including administration of medications and observation
methods_authorized.quote: "Emergency care" means the performance of acts or procedures under emergency conditions in the observation, care and counsel of persons who are ill or injured or who have disabilities; in the administration of care or medications prescribed by a licensed physician or naturopathic physician

drug_authority.value: EMS providers may administer medications prescribed by a licensed physician or naturopathic physician; standing orders may not exceed scope of practice defined by the Oregon Medical Board; patient care requires written authorization and standing orders from an approved supervising physician.
drug_authority.quote: An emergency medical services provider may not provide patient care or treatment without written authorization and standing orders from a supervising physician who has been approved by the board.

value: higher levels established by Oregon Health Authority by rule
certification_levels.quote: Levels of licensure for emergency medical services providers. The lowest level of emergency medical services provider licensure must be an emergency medical responder license.

national_registry_exam_required.quote: The Oregon Health Authority shall adopt rules to allow an applicant for licensure by indorsement as an emergency medical services provider to substitute experience and certification by a national registry of emergency medical services providers for education requirements imposed by the authority.

medical_director_required.quote: An emergency medical services provider may not provide patient care or treatment without written authorization and standing orders from a supervising physician who has been approved by the board.

standing_orders_authorized.quote: "Standing orders" means the written protocols that an emergency medical services provider follows to treat patients when direct contact with a physician is not maintained.

protocol_approval_process.value: The Oregon Medical Board adopts by rule a scope of practice for each level of EMS provider; standing orders may not exceed that scope; supervising physician must be approved by the Oregon Medical Board.
protocol_approval_process.quote: The Oregon Medical Board shall adopt by rule a scope of practice for each level of emergency medical services provider established by the Oregon Health Authority pursuant to ORS 682.017. The standing orders for emergency medical services providers may not exceed the scope of practice defined by the board.

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: A license for an ambulance service or the operation of ambulance vehicles shall be obtained from the Oregon Health Authority.

ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.quote: The Oregon Health Authority or its authorized representatives may at reasonable times inspect ambulances and ambulance services licensed or subject to being licensed under this chapter.

minimum_staffing_requirements.value: Each ambulance must be operated with at least one EMS provider licensed at a level higher than emergency medical responder when transporting a patient; specific staffing and equipment requirements for advanced life support and basic life support units are set by authority rule.
minimum_staffing_requirements.quote: A person or governmental unit may not operate or allow to be operated in this state any ambulance unless it is operated with at least one emergency medical services provider who is licensed at a level higher than emergency medical responder.

rural_county_staffing_exception.quote: The authority may waive any of the requirements imposed by this chapter in medically disadvantaged areas as determined by the Director of the Oregon Health Authority, or upon a showing that a severe hardship would result from enforcing a particular requirement.

regional_ems_council_structure.quote: The Oregon Health Authority shall, with the advice of the Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board, designate emergency medical services regions... The authority and the Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board shall establish a regional emergency medical services advisory board for each designated emergency medical services region.

statewide_ems_medical_director_position.quote: The program shall have a State EMS Medical Director who is the chairperson of the Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board established under ORS 682.506

trauma_system_designation.quote: The Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board, upon the advice of the Time-Sensitive Medical Emergencies Advisory Committee... shall determine the nationally recognized classification standards to recommend to the Oregon Health Authority to adopt as rules for categorization and designation of emergency medical services centers for the provision of trauma, stroke, cardiac, pediatric and behavioral health care

service_zone_or_primary_service_area_sys.quote: Each county shall develop a plan for the county or two or more contiguous counties may develop a plan relating to the need for and coordination of ambulance services and establish one or more ambulance service areas

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: A professional licensing board shall issue a temporary authorization to provide the occupational or professional service regulated by the professional licensing board to a person who: (a) Is the spouse of a member of the Armed Forces of the United States who is stationed in this state;

value: higher levels established by Oregon Health Authority by rule with scope defined by Oregon Medical Board
scope_of_practice_by_level.quote: The Oregon Medical Board shall adopt by rule a scope of practice for each level of emergency medical services provider established by the Oregon Health Authority pursuant to ORS 682.017.

treatment_of_police_dogs_authorized.quote: an emergency medical services provider may provide emergency transportation for treatment to a police dog that is injured in the line of duty, provided that such transportation for treatment does not delay or otherwise interfere with the emergency transportation for treatment of any human.

ems_data_collection_required.quote: Ambulance services shall report patient encounter data to the emergency medical services data system established under ORS 682.533 for each patient care event in accordance with rules adopted by the Oregon Health Authority under ORS 682.017.

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: An emergency medical services provider may not be held liable for acting in accordance with approved emergency medical services plans.

scope_of_practice_cannot_be_exceeded.quote: The standing orders for emergency medical services providers may not exceed the scope of practice defined by the board.
